title: Intentionally Overidentifying Local Projections
abstract: arXiv:2610.13269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local projections (LPs) have become a standard tool for estimating dynamic effects in macroeconomics and are typically implemented using ordinary least squares (OLS) for a given lag order. We propose an alternative approach that exploits additional lags as excluded instrumental variables (IVs). Under a finite-order model with martingale-difference shocks, the resulting (optimally weighted) IV estimator is never asymptotically less efficient than OLS and, as we show, can deliver substantial efficiency gains when data are persistent. For the unit-root AR(1) data with i.i.d. errors, our baseline IV estimator (with one overidentifying restriction) has asymptotic variance $2-h^{-1}$, compared with $h$, the asymptotic variance of the OLS lag-augmented estimator in Montiel Olea and Plagborg-M{\o}ller (2021), for an integer propagation horizon $h$. translated_title: 有意过度识别的局部投影
translated_abstract: 局部投影（LP）已成为宏观经济学中估计动态效应的标准工具，通常在给定滞后阶数下采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）进行估计。我们提出了一种替代方法，将额外的滞后项作为排除性工具变量（IV）加以利用。在具有鞅差分冲击的有限阶模型下，由此得到的（最优加权的）工具变量估计量在渐近意义上绝不逊于OLS的效率，并且我们证明，当数据具有持续性时，该方法能够带来显著的效率提升。对于误差项独立同分布的单位根AR(1)数据，在整数传播视界 h 下，我们的基准IV估计量（含一个过度识别约束）的渐近方差为 2−h⁻¹，而 Montiel Olea 与 Plagborg-Møller（2021）的OLS增广滞后估计量的渐近方差为 h。随后，我们发展了基于IV的LP推断方法，该方法对未知的持续性和中等程度的局部模型偏离具有稳健性。
tldr: 该论文提出将局部投影中额外的滞后项作为排除性工具变量，构造过度识别的IV估计量，证明其渐近效率绝不低于OLS，并且在数据具有持续性时能够获得显著的效率提升。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes exploiting extra lags in local projections as excluded instrumental variables, showing that the resulting overidentified IV estimator is never asymptotically less efficient than OLS and delivers substantial efficiency gains when the data are persistent.
